requirements: Scaffold covers the requested local recorder, six roles, exact-document hashes, reports, state/result separation, real-run metadata, journal and notes. Bootstrap raw receipts are an intentional approved exception. Four enforced lifecycle/persistence requirements fail independent reproductions.
architecture: Small standard-library recorder with authoritative state.json and event mirror is appropriate. No product work or external publishing added. Artifact persistence is not fully recovered.
correctness: REVISE: older reports remain eligible after newer failed runs, revision routes reuse old implementation/review, approval invalidation stops being enforced after BUILDING, and interrupted handoff can complete without required artifacts.

tests.results: 6 repository tests passed; 4 independent synthetic reproductions passed by asserting defective behavior. All reproduction state and Git fixtures were temporary. Candidate code/test working copies matched commit. Existing tests do not exercise these regressions.

security: No security-isolation claim. Work-item ID validation and separate current Implement identity checks are present. No external writes performed by this reviewer.
complexity: Scope and implementation size fit bootstrap. Fix the concrete gates/recovery paths rather than expanding into a scheduler or security framework.

findings.title: Gate on the latest run, including failed/blocked runs without reports
findings.reproduction: Build -> Review ACCEPT -> Verify PASS; dispatch another Verify run; close-run that run FAIL; advance READY_FOR_HANDOFF and handoff PASS both succeed. Reproduction: test_closed_failed_verify_still_passes.
findings.impact: A historical PASS overrules the newest failed verification. current_review/current_verify and candidate inspect reports only, while close-run records failures only in runs. Violates latest-attempt evidence gating.
findings.requested_change: Bind eligible evidence to the latest relevant run/attempt; a new running, failed, or blocked run must invalidate earlier successful evidence until properly resolved. Add regression coverage for latest Implement, Review, and Verify runs.

findings.title: Require a fresh implementation attempt after a revision route
findings.reproduction: Build -> Review ACCEPT -> Verify FAIL -> BUILDING -> REVIEWING -> VERIFYING succeeds with only the original Implement and Review reports. Reproduction: test_revision_can_skip_implement_and_review.
findings.impact: The required Implement and independent Review revision steps can be skipped; historical acceptance is reused after a failure and loop metrics count work that never occurred.
findings.requested_change: Require an Implement report produced for the current BUILDING entry before REVIEWING, then require a Review for that new attempt. Cover both Review and Verify revision routes.

findings.title: Recheck exact Spec approval through acceptance and handoff
findings.reproduction: Approve PRODUCT.md/TECH.md, submit Implement, enter REVIEWING, edit PRODUCT.md. spec_ready returns false, but Review ACCEPT -> Verify PASS -> handoff PASS -> COMPLETE all succeed. Reproduction: test_spec_change_after_reviewing_still_passes.
findings.impact: Unapproved changed requirements can receive a passing completed handoff. Approval validation currently ends at BUILDING -> REVIEWING.
findings.requested_change: Invalidate downstream eligibility when approved content changes and provide a validated route to reapproval and fresh candidate evidence. Cover edits during review, verify, and before handoff.

findings.title: Recover required handoff artifacts before allowing completion
findings.reproduction: Fault-inject OSError on the journal atomic write in cmd_handoff after canonical save. load/recover followed by advance COMPLETE succeeds while journal and PUBLIC_NOTES are absent. Reproduction: test_interrupted_handoff_completes_without_artifacts.
findings.impact: Interrupted persistence produces a completed handoff missing both required delivery artifacts. recover only repairs events.jsonl and COMPLETE checks only non-null handoff metadata.
findings.requested_change: Make handoff artifact generation recoverable/idempotent from canonical state, and require or repair required artifacts before COMPLETE. Test interrupted journal/public-note writes; also consider packet/report mirror recovery.

model_selection: Declared role defaults match approved policy and unavailable usage stays null. CLI accepts any gpt-* ID and does not enforce role defaults; actual selection still relies on Foreman procedure. No model invocation or billing fabricated.
metrics: First reported attempt success and direct loop counts are implemented; nullable usage is honest. Core gate defects currently permit misleading successful-handoff and loop metrics. Human-decision revision routes via WAITING_FOR_HUMAN are not counted as review-to-implement loops; this is a secondary measurement limitation.
